T=np.load('tok64.npz')
H=[T[f'L{l}'][:,KEEP].astype(np.float64) for l in range(13)]
for l in range(12):
    a,b=H[l],H[l+1]
    cos=np.mean(np.sum(a*b,1)/np.linalg.norm(a,axis=1)/np.linalg.norm(b,axis=1))
    rel=np.mean(np.linalg.norm(b-a,axis=1)/np.linalg.norm(a,axis=1))
    print('layer %d: cos(in,out)=%.3f rel change=%.3f'%(l,cos,rel))
# skip-two similarity
for l in range(11):
    a,b=H[l],H[l+2]
    print('skip %d..%d cos=%.3f'%(l,l+1,np.mean(np.sum(a*b,1)/np.linalg.norm(a,axis=1)/np.linalg.norm(b,axis=1))))
